page.overview:
Who is Adalgrim Took?

Adalgrim Took was a Hobbit of the Shire, and the grandfather of Meriadoc Brandybuck and Peregrin Took — part of The Lord of the Rings.

Adalgrim was the son of Hildigrim Took and Rosa Baggins. He had four daughters and one son. The youngest of his daughters was Esmeralda (Took) Brandybuck, the mother of Meriadoc Brandybuck.

entity.description:
Adalgrim Took was a Hobbit of the Shire, and the grandfather of Meriadoc Brandybuck and Peregrin Took.

Adalgrim was the son of Hildigrim Took and Rosa Baggins. He had four daughters and one son. The youngest of his daughters was Esmeralda (Took) Brandybuck, the mother of Meriadoc Brandybuck. Adalgrim's son was Paladin II Took, the father of Peregrin Took. Adalgrim was a cousin of Bilbo Baggins, although he did not attend Bilbo's Farewell Birthday Party in TA 3001. Although Adalgrim was never Shire-thain, his son Paladin became Shire-thain in TA 3015, when Ferumbras III Took, Paladin's cousin, died. Adalgrim died in TA 2982 (SR 1382).
